decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost pricing and licensing extension of the existing anamnesis app that opens the option to serve large practices, and its value is still uncertain after only one year, so keeping it open costs little.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants builds on the firm's existing customer base and support staff, so keeping it costs little while its uptake is still being learned, and dropping it now would give up an option whose value has not yet been revealed.
